package.description: Desktop app for viewing and editing .mdz (MDZip) files, with Windows Explorer preview integration.

en-US.description: Desktop app for viewing and editing .mdz (MDZip) files, with Windows Explorer preview integration.
en-US.longDescription:
MDZip Studio is the reference desktop application for the MDZip ecosystem: an
editor and validator for .mdz archives (Markdown plus images and metadata in a
single portable file). It provides a CommonMark/GFM Markdown editor and preview,
an asset browser, and manifest editing.

Installed per machine (winget install MDZip.Studio --scope machine), it also
registers a Windows Explorer preview handler for .mdz files. The default
per-user install is the application only.
en-US.name: MDZip Studio
